item.title: [6.9] European shares subdued as surging crude sharpens focus on ECB rate path
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

European shares were subdued on Monday as rising oil prices sparked by US-Iran tensions renewed inflation fears. Investors are closely monitoring the European Central Bank's upcoming interest rate decision, while a sharp decline in Novartis stock and German political uncertainty following regional elections further weighed on overall market sentiment.

WHY IT MATTERS

Rising oil prices driven by geopolitical tensions directly threaten the European inflation outlook ahead of a crucial ECB rate decision.
